title: Division Expressions with Fractions and Whole Numbers

items.stem: What is the value of the expression 3/4 ÷ 2?
A recipe calls for 2/3 cup of sugar. If you want to make only half of the recipe, how many cups of sugar do you need?
Select ALL expressions that are equivalent to 5/6 ÷ 1/2.
Calculate the value of 4 ÷ 2/5. Show or explain your work to justify your answer.
